title: Erratic driving led police to charge drunken motorist
article: Driving with more than twice the legal limit of alcohol in his blood earned an Elora man a $750 fine and a one-year driving prohibition in a Guelph court.

James Hammond's erratic driving caught the attention of police Dec. 10 as he headed home, court was told recently. The 52-year-old was speeding up and slowing down and driving on the wrong side of the road. And he failed to stop at a stop sign before he was confronted after backing into his driveway.
Hammond told police he had "a couple of drinks at a friend's house" but later blew more than twice the limit on a blood alcohol test, court heard.
